summary: SPK RC 42 sua playback/timeline/annotation/comment tren man review va go bo hoan toan luong deploy Docker — SPK la kenh deploy duy nhat.
changes: Video khong con tu dung khi he thong re-render (presence/comment/transcode event): phan tu <video> duoc giu nguyen qua cac lan render nen buffer khong bi vut bo giua chung.
Tu dong phat tiep sau khi het nghen buffer (canplaythrough hoac da dem truoc >=20s); nguoi dung chu dong pause thi van dung yen.
Buffer bat dau ngay khi mo video (preload=auto) va hls.js giu toi da 40s phia truoc, back-buffer 30s.
Timeline: di chuot chi hien tooltip timecode, khong con pause + seek video theo con tro; click moi seek va giu nguyen trang thai phat.
Ve chu thich muot va chinh xac hon: chi ve lai net dang keo moi frame, dung coalesced pointer events, khong cat mat phan dau net dai.
Comment hien ngay sau khi gui, khong can refresh trang; gui loi se co toast bao.
Worker bao loi mount qua driver db chung nen hoat dong dung tren SPK/sqlite.
Go bo toan bo Docker flow: compose files, Dockerfile, Caddyfile, workflow GHCR, script watchtower/nas-update. Deploy va update chi qua SPK + DSM Package Center.
